name: gemini-cost
description: Checks Google AI Studio / Gemini API usage and billing for a project through the user's signed-in browser: requests and tokens per model, cost before and after credits, Developer Program credit remaining, prepaid balance, and rate-limit tier. Read-only — never touches settings, budgets, keys or payment methods, and never calls the Gemini generative API. Uses no API key or stored credential of any kind.
